strings.name: Bhavish Aggarwal
strings.role: Ola co-founder · Ola Electric chairman and managing director
strings.summary: Bhavish Aggarwal co-founded Ola with Ankit Bhati, later developing Ola Electric’s EV business and the Krutrim AI venture. He is Ola Electric’s chairman and managing director. The ride-hailing, EV and AI businesses are distinct entities whose results and risks should be understood separately.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Founding and operations, launch and delivery, and corporate views and results are distinguished. Recalls and losses retained; birth to year only.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Ola and developed electric mobility, advancing ride-hailing platforms and new-energy transport entrepreneurship in India.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Earned a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering from IIT Bombay in 2008.
strings.facts.f2.label: Early career
strings.facts.f2.value: Worked at Microsoft Research for about two years before leaving in 2010 to start a business.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Mobility entrepreneurship
strings.highlights.h1.text: With Ankit Bhati, connected passengers and taxi operators through a technology platform, retaining co-founder, driver and team contributions.
strings.highlights.h2.title: EV and AI businesses
strings.highlights.h2.text: Advanced electric two-wheelers and Krutrim; teams develop the products, and AI claims and industrial plans do not establish independent validation or full delivery.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Discusses supply and dealer transition
strings.timeline.t1.text: In the second-quarter shareholder letter, identifies supply bottlenecks as a constraint; Ola Electric still posts a consolidated loss. The assessment is his.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Ola Electric begins public trading
strings.timeline.t2.text: The EV company makes its Indian market debut; this is not a listing of Ola ride-hailing or Krutrim.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Presents Krutrim AI models
strings.timeline.t3.text: At a launch event, introduces models aimed at Indian languages and needs; public services and developer APIs were then planned in stages.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Ola Electric announces recall
strings.timeline.t4.text: After a vehicle fire, the company announces a voluntary recall of 1,441 scooters from a specific batch for inspection; preliminary explanations are not final investigation findings.
strings.timeline.t5.title: S1 Pro deliveries begin
strings.timeline.t5.text: The prospectus dates first deliveries of Ola Electric’s initial EV, S1 Pro, to this month; the earlier product launch is not the delivery date.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Ola Electric incorporates
strings.timeline.t6.text: The EV business entity incorporates in Bengaluru as a private limited company, later converting to a public limited company.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Co-founds venture with Ankit Bhati
strings.timeline.t7.text: Co-founds Ola; an early interview dates the start of operations to late December.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Graduates from IIT Bombay
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completes an undergraduate degree in Computer Science and Engineering, then joins Microsoft Research.
